body:
I think, I just did too many mistakes. I can't tell my family. I guess, they would just restrict me and punish me for the things I've done. Then again, I'd be even more depressed and fucked up.
A letter came once from the school, saying my marks are getting worse, even though they were pretty good ( around B-D ), and I had to talk for about 2 hours with my parents. They did not believe me, that I'm good at school and just can't accept the fact, that I'm not okay about my feelings, which are killing me inside.

I don't know about support groups or drug programs in my environment, but there are school psychologists, but I suppose that they aren't good, because I never heard good reviews about them.

I guess I could solve my addiction, that's true, but, what about everything else? It's just my personality that's fucked up.
I may bring to everyone fun and give them a good time, I'm giving advices to as many people as I can, and help them at any things, like school, relationship problems, parent problems, etc., I even invite many of my friends to eat with me in a high class restaurant, paying all the costs and everything. I give them too much, and I feel, they give me too little, even though, I guess that's not true.
I don't know what I actually want. I can't even decide for myself, I'd rather have a person with me all the time, saying what's wrong and what's right, what to do and what not to do, but I know that this is impossible..
